title: Junior Cook
description:
Desi Dragon - DM Plaza

Reports to: Executive Chef / Sous Chef

The Junior Cook supports the kitchen team with preparation, basic station responsibilities, recipe execution, sanitation, and service support while continuing to develop professional culinary skills.

Key Responsibilities
• Complete assigned prep work.
• Wash, cut, portion, measure, and prepare ingredients.
• Prepare approved menu components according to recipes.
• Assist senior cooks during service.
• Maintain station cleanliness and organization.
• Follow food-storage, labeling, dating, and rotation procedures.
• Follow sanitation and temperature-control requirements.
• Replenish station ingredients.
• Report shortages or quality concerns.
• Assist with opening and closing tasks.
• Learn additional stations as skills develop.
requirements:
Required Qualifications
• Minimum 3 years of relevant food-service, culinary, food-preparation, or commercial kitchen experience.
• Basic professional cooking and knife skills.
• Ability to follow recipes and instructions accurately.
• Basic food-safety knowledge.
• Ability to work quickly and safely.
• Willingness to learn multiple stations.

Core Soft Skills
• Coachability and reliability.
• Attention to detail and teamwork.
• Positive attitude and sense of urgency.
• Cleanliness and organization.
• Respectful communication.
• Willingness to learn.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Indian or Chinese cuisine.
• Culinary training.
• Comfort appearing and speaking on camera for appropriate restaurant marketing, team content, or promotional activities.
• Ability to speak Bengali is a plus but is not required.

questions.label: Situational question
questions.helpText:
During a busy service, a Junior Cook finishes an assigned prep task but notices that another station is running low on ingredients. At the same time, the Sous Chef gives a new instruction that the Junior Cook has not performed before.

The candidate should explain how they would handle the situation, including:

What they would do first.

How they would clarify an unfamiliar instruction.

How they would decide whether to help the other station.

How they would make sure the task is completed safely and correctly.

What they would do if they realized they had made a mistake.

The response should be concise but detailed enough to demonstrate coachability, communication, judgment, teamwork, and willingness to learn.

application_instructions:
Apply using the form on this page. Include:
• Current resume.
• Any relevant culinary training or certifications.
• A written response to the situational question below.

title: Dishwasher / Kitchen Steward
description:
Desi Dragon - DM Plaza

Reports to: Sous Chef / Executive Chef / Restaurant Manager

The Dishwasher / Kitchen Steward is responsible for maintaining clean and sanitary dishes, cookware, utensils, equipment, and kitchen work areas, helping keep the kitchen safe, organized, and ready for continuous service.

Key Responsibilities
• Wash and sanitize dishes, cookware, pots, pans, utensils, and equipment.
• Operate commercial dishwashing equipment safely.
• Properly store clean dishes and equipment.
• Maintain an organized dishwashing area.
• Sweep and mop assigned areas.
• Remove trash and recycling.
• Clean kitchen surfaces and designated equipment.
• Maintain sanitation supplies.
• Assist with moving and stocking kitchen supplies.
• Follow chemical-handling and sanitation procedures.
• Complete opening and closing cleaning assignments.
• Immediately report sanitation hazards, leaks, or damaged equipment.
• Support continuous kitchen cleanliness during service.
requirements:
Required Qualifications
• Minimum 3 years of restaurant dishwashing, kitchen stewarding, sanitation, utility, or comparable commercial food-service experience.
• Understanding of sanitation procedures.
• Familiarity with commercial dishwashing equipment preferred.
• Ability to work efficiently in a physically active environment.
• Ability to follow safety and cleaning procedures consistently.

Core Soft Skills
• Dependability and strong work ethic.
• Cleanliness and attention to detail.
• Cooperation and sense of urgency.
• Accountability and organization.
• Positive attitude.

Preferred Qualifications
• High-volume restaurant experience.
• Familiarity with commercial kitchen sanitation.
• Comfort appearing and speaking on camera for appropriate restaurant marketing, team content, or promotional activities.
• Ability to speak Bengali is a plus but is not required.

questions.label: Situational question
questions.helpText:
During a busy dinner service, the dish area is becoming backed up, the kitchen is urgently requesting clean cookware, the dining room needs additional clean plates, and a spill near the dish station creates a potential safety hazard.

The candidate should explain how they would handle the situation, including:

What they would address first and why.

How they would prioritize the different dishwashing needs.

How they would handle the safety hazard.

How they would communicate with the kitchen or front-of-house team.

What they would do to bring the dish area back under control.

The response should be concise but detailed enough to demonstrate prioritization, safety awareness, communication, organization, and ability to work under pressure.

application_instructions:
Apply using the form on this page. Include:
• Current resume.
• Any relevant food-safety or sanitation certifications, if available.
• A written response to the situational question below.

title: Maintenance Team Member
description:
DM Plaza / Desi Dragon

Reports to: Restaurant Manager

The Maintenance Team Member supports safe, clean, functional, and well-maintained restaurant facilities through routine inspections, basic preventive maintenance, minor repairs, and prompt reporting of issues requiring specialized service.

Key Responsibilities
• Conduct routine facility inspections.
• Perform basic preventive maintenance.
• Identify and report damaged equipment, fixtures, doors, flooring, plumbing, lighting, or other facility issues.
• Complete minor repairs within training and authorization.
• Help maintain restaurant furniture, fixtures, storage areas, and non-specialized equipment.
• Coordinate access for approved outside maintenance vendors when directed.
• Maintain maintenance logs and report recurring problems.
• Support opening and closing facility checks.
• Assist with moving equipment and supplies safely.
• Maintain tools and maintenance materials properly.
• Immediately report electrical, fire-safety, plumbing, structural, or other significant hazards.
• Do not perform licensed work unless appropriately qualified and authorized.
requirements:
Required Qualifications
• Minimum 3 years of maintenance, facilities, property operations, restaurant maintenance, or comparable experience.
• Basic knowledge of common maintenance tools and procedures.
• Ability to identify facility or equipment problems.
• Ability to perform basic repairs safely.
• Strong attention to safety.
• Ability to maintain maintenance records.

Core Soft Skills
• Reliability and attention to detail.
• Problem solving and safety awareness.
• Initiative and organization.
• Accountability and adaptability.
• Professionalism and good communication.

Preferred Qualifications
• Restaurant, hospitality, retail, or commercial-property maintenance experience.
• Basic plumbing, carpentry, hardware, or equipment-maintenance experience.
• Comfort appearing and speaking on camera for appropriate restaurant marketing, team content, or promotional activities.
• Ability to speak Bengali is a plus but is not required.

questions.label: Situational question
questions.helpText:
During an operating shift, a Maintenance Team Member is informed that water is beginning to collect near a kitchen fixture. At the same time, a dining-room light has stopped working, a door is not closing properly, and the Restaurant Manager asks for an update on another open maintenance issue.

The candidate should explain how they would handle the situation, including:

What they would address first and why.

How they would determine whether an issue can be handled safely within their role.

What they would do if the water issue appeared to require a licensed plumber or specialized technician.

How they would communicate the situation to the Restaurant Manager.

How they would document and follow up on the remaining maintenance issues.

The response should be concise but detailed enough to demonstrate safety awareness, prioritization, judgment, communication, and problem-solving ability.

application_instructions:
Apply using the form on this page. Include:
• Current resume.
• Any relevant trade, safety, facilities, or equipment certifications, if available.
• A written response to the situational question below.

title: Mocktail Bartender / Beverage Specialist
description:
Desi Dragon - DM Plaza

Reports to: Restaurant Manager / FOH Supervisor

The Mocktail Bartender / Beverage Specialist prepares visually appealing, consistent, and high-quality nonalcoholic beverages while delivering a strong guest experience. The role combines beverage technique, creativity, speed, cleanliness, and confident guest interaction.

Key Responsibilities
• Prepare mocktails and other approved beverages according to standardized recipes.
• Measure ingredients accurately.
• Maintain consistency in taste, appearance, garnish, and portion size.
• Prepare syrups, garnishes, infusions, mixes, and beverage components.
• Maintain an organized and sanitary beverage station.
• Take beverage orders from guests or service staff.
• Explain ingredients and recommend drinks.
• Support development and testing of new mocktails.
• Monitor ingredient freshness and quality.
• Follow proper storage, labeling, and sanitation procedures.
• Communicate supply shortages to management.
• Minimize unnecessary beverage waste.
• Clean beverage equipment, glassware, tools, and work areas.
• Support special events and promotional beverage service.
requirements:
Required Qualifications
• Minimum 3 years of professional bartending, mocktail, specialty beverage, cafe, restaurant beverage, or comparable beverage-service experience.
• Strong beverage-preparation skills.
• Knowledge of flavor balancing, garnishing, and presentation.
• Strong customer-service skills.
• Ability to consistently follow beverage recipes.
• Ability to perform efficiently during busy service.

Core Soft Skills
• Creativity and social confidence.
• Guest engagement and communication.
• Attention to detail and reliability.
• Organization and positive attitude.
• Teamwork, adaptability, and professionalism.

Preferred Qualifications
• Mocktail-development experience.
• Knowledge of South Asian or Asian flavors.
• Experience developing visually appealing beverages.
• Strong camera presence and comfort demonstrating drinks for social media.
• Ability to speak Bengali is a plus but is not required.

questions.label: Situational question
questions.helpText:
During a busy dinner service, several beverage orders are waiting, one key mocktail ingredient is running low, a guest says their drink tastes different from the last time they ordered it, and a Server asks for a recommendation for another guest who prefers something refreshing but not too sweet.

The candidate should explain how they would handle the situation, including:

What they would address first and why.

How they would handle the inconsistent drink.

How they would manage the ingredient shortage.

How they would recommend an appropriate drink to the guest.

How they would keep the beverage station organized while handling multiple orders.

What they would do after service to help prevent the same consistency or supply issue from happening again.

The response should be concise but detailed enough to demonstrate beverage knowledge, prioritization, guest service, communication, consistency, and problem-solving ability.

application_instructions:
Apply using the form on this page. Include:
• Current resume.
• Photos, menus, beverage portfolios, or other examples of previous work, if available.
• A written response to the situational question below.

title: Lead Barista
description:
Pearl & Leaf is seeking a strong working Lead Barista who genuinely lives for drink making, tasting, testing, and iteration, has excellent taste, and can help build and refine the Pearl & Leaf beverage menu while remaining fully hands-on in daily service. This is not an overbuilt beverage-director role. The right person should enjoy making drinks themselves, turning ideas into testable concepts, improving recipes repeatedly, training teammates, and keeping quality consistent shift after shift.
What This Role Owns
• Work regular barista shifts and personally prepare drinks during normal service.
• Take beverage ideas from leadership and turn them into practical, testable drink concepts.
• Create, test, and iterate milk teas, fruit teas, matcha beverages, coffee drinks, seasonal drinks, and specialty beverages.
• Evaluate flavor, sweetness, acidity, texture, aroma, temperature, dilution, and presentation, and clearly explain why a drink works or does not work.
• Standardize successful recipes so they can be reproduced consistently by other employees.
• Train baristas on recipes, technique, workflow, presentation, sanitation, and service standards.
• Monitor drink consistency during service and coach the team when quality drifts.
• Help develop prep methods, batch recipes, station setup, labeling, and beverage production procedures.
• Work with the Store Manager on ingredient needs, shortages, quality issues, and operational requirements.
• Participate in tastings, seasonal menu development, launch preparation, and product feedback sessions.
• Interact naturally with customers and gather useful feedback on new and existing drinks.
• Participate in beverage-focused social media, product launches, demonstrations, and marketing content when requested.

Brand and Marketing Expectations
• Comfortable appearing and speaking on camera for appropriate Pearl & Leaf and DM Plaza content.
• Able to explain drinks, ingredients, flavor choices, and preparation in a natural and engaging way.
• Comfortable participating in drink launches, tastings, demonstrations, behind-the-scenes content, and other marketing activities.

Why Join Pearl & Leaf
This is an opportunity for a beverage professional to help shape Pearl & Leaf from the beginning, not simply step into an already established menu and routine.
The role offers:
• Meaningful product ownership. The Lead Barista will have a direct role in developing, testing, refining, and standardizing Pearl & Leaf beverages.
• A hands-on creative role. This position is designed for someone who enjoys actually making drinks, tasting, experimenting, and improving recipes rather than managing from a distance.
• Influence over the opening beverage program. The Lead Barista will help establish drink standards, prep systems, training practices, and operating procedures as Pearl & Leaf develops.
• Room to experiment and improve. Strong ideas can move from concept to testing, refinement, and launch rather than getting stuck in lengthy approval processes.
• Autonomy with accountability. DM Plaza aims to give strong performers room to work without unnecessary micromanagement while maintaining clear expectations for quality, execution, and results.
• Performance-driven growth. Strong performance and measurable contribution can create opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation over time.
• Access to modern tools and systems. The role will work with operational technology, including Toast POS, and will be part of a broader effort to build efficient, modern workflows.
• Training and leadership opportunity. The Lead Barista will help develop other baristas and shape the quality culture of the beverage team.
• Visible creative work. The role includes participation in tastings, launches, beverage demonstrations, social content, and customer-facing product moments.
• A role within a growing hospitality concept. Pearl & Leaf is part of the broader DM Plaza project, giving the Lead Barista exposure to restaurant, event, retail, and community initiatives beyond a typical standalone cafe role.
requirements:
Hard Skills and Technical Requirements
• Minimum 3 years of professional barista, specialty beverage, cafe, bubble tea, tea, or comparable beverage experience.
• Strong hands-on beverage preparation skills and demonstrated knowledge of recipe balance and consistency.
• Experience with at least several of the following: espresso, coffee, tea, milk tea, fruit tea, matcha, syrups, toppings, cold beverages, shaken drinks, or blended beverages.
• Ability to convert a concept into a repeatable recipe with specific ingredients, quantities, steps, yield, and presentation standards.
• Ability to taste analytically and explain adjustments clearly.
• Understanding of beverage station setup, sanitation, food handling, storage, labeling, and freshness standards.
• Ability to train others and maintain recipe consistency across different employees and shifts.
• Comfort working quickly and accurately during high-volume service.
• Comfort using Toast POS and basic operational checklists.
Soft Skills We Value
• Deep passion for beverages. The ideal candidate genuinely lives for drink making, tasting, testing, and iteration.
• Strong creative taste without losing sight of consistency or operational practicality.
• Experimentation mindset and willingness to test, receive feedback, and improve repeatedly.
• Clear communication and ability to explain flavor decisions simply.
• Coachability and willingness to collaborate with leadership rather than treating menu development as a solo function.
• Patience when training others.
• Attention to detail.
• Reliability and ownership.
• Warm, guest-friendly personality.
• Organization and cleanliness.
• Bias toward making, testing, and improving rather than over-planning.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience developing original beverage recipes or seasonal specials.
• Experience with milk tea, fruit tea, matcha, specialty coffee, or Asian beverage concepts.
• Experience training junior baristas.
• Restaurant or cafe opening experience.
• Portfolio, photos, recipes, menus, or examples of drinks personally created.
• Ability to speak Bengali is a plus but is not required.

questions.label: Tell us about a beverage you developed or significantly improved. What did you change, why, and what was the result?

application_instructions: Apply using the form on this page. A résumé is required. A link or PDFs showing drinks, menus, or recipes you created are welcome but optional.

title: Content & Community Manager
description:
DM Plaza is seeking a hands-on Content & Community Manager who can find stories in what is already happening, capture them quickly, and turn them into compelling content and community momentum. This role is much broader than scheduling social posts. The right person should be comfortable filming constantly, talking naturally with people, spotting interesting personalities and moments, shaping messy ideas into clear stories, building genuine relationships, and continuously looking for ways to improve the creative and community work.
Core Responsibilities
• Regularly capture photo and video content across DM Plaza, Desi Dragon, Pearl & Leaf, Meridian Hill, Nature's Bazaar, and other relevant operations or events.
• Identify stories already happening inside the businesses instead of relying only on pre-planned campaign concepts.
• Find interesting personalities among staff, customers, creators, vendors, partners, and community members and develop story angles around them.
• Turn rough ideas, founder thoughts, operational updates, launches, and community moments into clear content narratives.
• Develop short-form video concepts, interview formats, behind-the-scenes stories, launch content, event content, community features, and other platform-appropriate creative.
• Film, edit, package, and publish or coordinate publication of content with a bias toward consistent output and learning.
• Use current, modern tools for video editing and content management, and stay current as stronger tools and workflows emerge.
• Maintain a practical content calendar without allowing scheduling administration to become the center of the role.
• Review content performance and use results to improve future creative decisions.
• Identify creators, local groups, cultural communities, organizations, events, and partnership opportunities relevant to DM Plaza.
• Initiate outreach and help nurture relationships when appropriate.
• Coordinate partnership opportunities when ownership belongs to leadership or another team member.
• Support event promotion and community activation, especially for Meridian Hill, without relying only on paid advertising.
• Help build repeatable processes for capturing stories, organizing footage, tracking creator/community relationships, and following up on opportunities.
• Once the content workflow is established, manage and direct an editing resource who supports post-production under this role. This support may be added after the role has established a working content process.
What This Role Is Not
• Not primarily a social media scheduling or posting administrator.
• Not expected to own every external relationship personally.
• Not a purely strategy-only marketing role.
• Not dependent on large production crews or polished campaign budgets to make useful content.
• Not limited to digital engagement; the role should connect online storytelling with real-world community relationships and events.

What Success Looks Like
• DM Plaza consistently captures and publishes stories that feel real, specific, and connected to the people and businesses inside the plaza.
• The team develops a steady pipeline of useful content ideas from day-to-day operations, launches, staff, guests, and events.
• Leadership can share a rough thought and receive a clear, usable story or content structure in return.
• DM Plaza steadily expands its network of creators, community groups, cultural organizations, and potential partners.
• Meridian Hill and other DM Plaza events gain community momentum through relationships, content, creator involvement, and targeted outreach, not only paid advertising.
• The role produces tangible creative output consistently rather than becoming primarily administrative.
requirements:
Hard Skills and Experience
• Relevant professional experience in content creation, social media, community, brand marketing, creative production, journalism, creator partnerships, events, or a closely related field is preferred, but strong instincts and demonstrated work can outweigh a traditional years-of-experience profile.
• Strong short-form video instincts and ability to shoot useful content quickly with a phone or lightweight camera setup.
• Demonstrated experience creating content personally, not only managing outside creators or agencies.
• Ability to structure a story with a clear hook, point of view, progression, and payoff.
• Strong working knowledge of short-form editing, common social media content formats, and current video editing and content management tools.
• Ability to conduct natural interviews and make non-media-trained people feel comfortable on camera.
• Ability to turn loosely structured ideas into concise scripts, outlines, captions, or video structures.
• Strong written communication and copy judgment.
• Ability to organize footage, ideas, content pipelines, contact lists, and follow-ups.
• Comfort reviewing basic performance metrics and using them to improve creative output.
Community and Partnership Skills
• Strong social confidence and ability to build rapport naturally with many types of people.
• Able to identify communities, creators, cultural organizations, businesses, and groups that could be relevant to DM Plaza.
• Comfortable initiating outreach in person, by email, DM, or other appropriate channels.
• Able to distinguish between opportunities they should own directly and those that should transition to leadership or another team member.
• Able to help coordinate collaborations, creator visits, community events, cross-promotions, and relationship follow-up.
• Understands that community-building requires repeated contact and trust, not only one-time promotion.
Soft Skills We Value
• Storytelling instinct.
• Curiosity about people and communities.
• Social confidence without being overly scripted.
• Strong creative taste.
• Initiative and proactive idea generation.
• Bias toward making and publishing rather than endless planning.
• Ability to work from incomplete or messy direction.
• Good judgment about what is interesting, respectful, and brand-appropriate.
• Genuine relationship-building mindset and a strong preference for earning trust through repeated contact and follow-through.
• Adaptability in a fast-moving launch environment.
• Organization and follow-through.
• Collaborative working style.
• Comfort receiving direct creative feedback and iterating quickly.
• Continuous-improvement mindset. Regularly looks for what can be made better and is highly motivated to improve creative output, workflow, and community results.
On-Camera Expectations
• Must be highly comfortable filming people regularly and working around a camera as part of normal operations.
• Should also be comfortable appearing on camera when appropriate, including introductions, interviews, event coverage, or behind-the-scenes content.
• Professional acting or presenter experience is not required; natural communication and confidence are more important.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience building content for restaurants, hospitality, retail, events, food, culture, lifestyle, or community-focused brands.
• Experience with creator partnerships or community activations.
• Strong familiarity with New York City neighborhoods, communities, creators, cultural organizations, or event ecosystems.
• Experience covering live events and producing content quickly from them.
• Portfolio showing personally created short-form video and storytelling work.
• Ability to speak Bengali is a plus but is not required.

questions.label: What did you personally contribute to the work in your portfolio?
In 100 words or fewer, which piece best represents your storytelling ability, and why?
Give one example of content you created that performed well. What happened, what drove the result, and what did you learn?
If we gave you raw DM Plaza footage, how would you turn it into useful content? No editing or production is required for this application.
questions.helpText: Describe the story angle, hook, structure, additional footage or interviews, format, and how you would judge success.

questions.label: Are you comfortable filming and interviewing people, editing content, and appearing on camera when appropriate?
Can you cover occasional weekend events when scheduled in advance?

application_instructions: Apply using the form on this page. A résumé and portfolio link are required. Answer the role-specific questions below.

title: Executive Chef Practical Assessment Judge
description:
DM Plaza is seeking two experienced professional chefs or senior cooks to serve as independent judges for the practical assessment of Executive Chef candidates for Desi Dragon. Judges will provide objective professional evaluation of cooking ability, kitchen organization, food quality, sanitation, culinary judgment, leadership, and overall Executive Chef readiness. Judges may come from any cuisine background. DM Plaza is seeking judges with at least 10 years of professional culinary experience and with experience and seniority sufficient to evaluate an Executive Chef candidate at a higher professional level.
• Judges provide professional input and independent scoring. Final hiring authority remains with DM Plaza leadership.
Key Responsibilities
• Observe Executive Chef candidates during assigned practical-test sections.
• Evaluate candidates using the standardized DM Plaza assessment rubric.
• Independently score the areas assigned to the judge.
• Assess technical cooking ability, mise en place, kitchen organization, ingredient handling, and knife skills.
• Review food quality, flavor, texture, temperature, doneness, and presentation.
• Evaluate cleanliness, sanitation, and food-safety practices.
• Observe time management and ability to work under pressure.
• Assess organization, problem solving, professional judgment, leadership, and communication where observable.
Scoring and Feedback
• Complete the assigned assessment scorecard independently.
• Support scores with specific observations.
• Identify major strengths demonstrated by each candidate.
• Identify technical or operational concerns.
• Distinguish personal culinary preferences from actual performance deficiencies.
• Participate in a post-assessment judge discussion.
• Explain professional observations to the hiring team.
• Provide an overall written assessment of the candidate.

Cuisine Background
Judges do not need to specialize in Indian or Chinese cuisine. Experienced chefs from any professional culinary background may be considered because the assessment also covers universal professional capabilities such as technique, organization, sanitation, execution, judgment, and leadership. Strong Indian or Chinese culinary experience is valued but is not required.

Independence and Conflict of Interest
• Disclose if the judge personally knows a candidate.
• Disclose any previous employment, supervision, business relationship, or other connection that could affect impartiality.
• Accept reassignment of a candidate or assessment section if DM Plaza determines a material conflict exists.
Expected Deliverables
• Completed candidate scorecard.
• Written notes supporting significant scores.
• Key strengths and key concerns.
• Any food-safety or professional-conduct concerns.
• Assessment of technical culinary readiness.
• Assessment of leadership readiness where observable.
• Recommended areas for follow-up during the hiring process.
requirements:
Required Qualifications
• Minimum 10 years of professional chef or cook experience in a commercial food-service environment, with experience and seniority sufficient to evaluate an Executive Chef candidate at a higher professional level.
• Current or previous senior culinary experience such as Executive Chef, Head Chef, Chef de Cuisine, Sous Chef, Executive Sous Chef, Senior Cook, Kitchen Manager with strong hands-on culinary experience, or comparable role.
• Strong hands-on culinary knowledge and understanding of professional cooking techniques.
• Ability to assess food objectively.
• Understanding of kitchen sanitation and food-safety standards.
• Ability to communicate observations clearly.
• Ability to complete written scoring and feedback.
• Willing and available to attend the scheduled Executive Chef practical-assessment day in person and judge candidates for the full assigned session.

Required Soft Skills
• Objectivity and fairness.
• Attention to detail.
• Professional judgment.
• Clear communication.
• Integrity.
• Constructive feedback.
• Collaboration while maintaining an independent opinion.

Preferred Qualifications
• Previous experience evaluating, training, mentoring, or hiring chefs.
• Culinary-school teaching or training experience.
• Restaurant-opening experience.
• Experience as an Executive Chef or Head Chef.
• High-volume restaurant experience.
• Food Protection or comparable food-safety certification.
• Strong Indian, Chinese, or Indo-Chinese cuisine experience is preferred and may qualify for a higher compensation range.
• Experience judging culinary competitions or practical cooking assessments.
compensation: $75–$150 per hour for a one-day engagement

questions.label: Can you attend a full, one-day, in-person culinary assessment in Jamaica, Queens?
Do you know any current Executive Chef candidate or have a relationship that might affect your independence? If none, write “None.”

application_instructions: Apply using the form on this page. A résumé or professional culinary profile is required; relevant certifications may be uploaded as PDFs.

title: Executive Chef
description:
Desi Dragon is seeking an experienced, hands-on Executive Chef to lead culinary operations and build a disciplined, high-performing kitchen team. The role leads menu execution, recipe development, food quality, kitchen workflow, sanitation, training, waste control, and team performance. Professional experience with both Indian and Chinese cuisine is required; Indo-Chinese experience is highly preferred.
• Purchasing, vendor management, inventory accounting, supplier negotiations, and overall restaurant food-cost management are primarily owned by the Restaurant Manager.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead all culinary and kitchen operations.
• Maintain strong standards for Indian and Chinese cuisine.
• Develop, test, document, and standardize recipes.
• Establish plating, portioning, preparation, and food-quality standards.
• Supervise and develop the Sous Chef, Line Cooks, Junior Cooks, and kitchen support staff.
• Train kitchen employees on recipes, techniques, equipment use, sanitation, and kitchen procedures.
• Organize prep systems, stations, mise en place, production schedules, and kitchen workflows.
• Monitor service execution and resolve kitchen bottlenecks.
• Conduct food-quality checks before and during service.
• Minimize waste, overproduction, preparation errors, and improper portioning.
• Maintain kitchen sanitation and inspection readiness.
• Establish opening, closing, cleaning, and food-safety procedures.
• Collaborate with the Restaurant Manager regarding ingredient needs, shortages, quality concerns, and operational requirements.
• Support hiring and practical assessment of kitchen employees.
• Participate in menu development, tastings, special events, guest interactions, and restaurant promotions.

Why Join Desi Dragon
This is an opportunity for an experienced Executive Chef to help shape the culinary foundation of a new restaurant from the ground up.
The role offers:
• A major leadership opportunity. The Executive Chef will have meaningful influence over kitchen systems, recipe standards, team development, service execution, and the overall culinary direction of Desi Dragon.
• A spacious professional kitchen environment. The kitchen is being designed to support serious restaurant operations, training, organization, and high-volume execution.
• Access to modern tools and technology. DM Plaza intends to equip its teams with strong operational and restaurant technology to support efficient day-to-day work.
• Autonomy with accountability. The work environment is intended to give strong performers room to lead without unnecessary micromanagement, while maintaining clear expectations around execution, quality, and results.
• Performance-driven growth. Strong performance, leadership, and measurable results can create opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation over time.
• An opportunity to build a team. The Executive Chef will help shape, train, and develop the kitchen team during the restaurant’s opening phase.
• Creative involvement. The role includes participation in menu development, recipe testing, tastings, events, guest experiences, and restaurant promotions.
• A visible role in a growing hospitality concept. The Executive Chef will be part of the opening and development of Desi Dragon within the broader DM Plaza project.
requirements:
Required Qualifications
• Minimum 5-10 years of professional culinary experience, including at least 3-6 years in a kitchen leadership capacity.
• Demonstrated professional experience preparing Indian and Chinese cuisine.
• Strong knowledge of Indian spices, curries, proteins, rice preparations, breads, sauces, and regional flavor profiles.
• Strong knowledge of Chinese wok cooking, marinades, sauces, stir-frying, steaming, frying, and preparation techniques.
• Strong knife and professional cooking skills.
• Experience developing and standardizing recipes.
• Experience training and supervising kitchen staff.
• Strong food-safety and sanitation knowledge.
• Ability to lead high-volume service.
• Strong verbal communication and organizational ability.
• Availability Monday through Sunday according to the agreed employment schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.
Core Soft Skills
• Leadership and accountability.
• Strong communication and coaching ability.
• Attention to detail and organization.
• Decision-making and problem solving.
• Creativity and adaptability.
• Calmness under pressure.
• Professionalism and guest awareness.

Preferred Qualifications
• Indo-Chinese culinary experience.
• Restaurant-opening experience.
• Catering or events experience.
• NYC Food Protection Certificate.
• Comfort appearing and speaking on camera for appropriate restaurant marketing, team content, or promotional activities.
• Ability to speak Bengali is a plus but is not required.

questions.label: How would you handle a delayed dinner service, a Line Cook callout, a returned dish, and a station that is not following the recipe?
questions.helpText:
During a busy dinner service at Desi Dragon, several orders are already delayed, one of the strongest Line Cooks calls out unexpectedly, and a guest returns a dish because the flavor is inconsistent with a previous visit. At the same time, the Executive Chef notices that one kitchen station is not following the standardized recipe correctly.
The candidate should explain how they would handle the situation, including:
What they would address first and why.
How they would reorganize the kitchen team for the remainder of service.
How they would handle the guest's food-quality concern.
How they would address the employee who was not following the standardized recipe.
